title: Contoso adopts an agent-native engineering system
summary: Every delivery team now plans, builds, reviews and secures software with AI agents working alongside developers on GitHub.

title: Security operations centre completes its annual ISO/IEC 27001 audit
summary: The 24/7 security operations centre in Jakarta passed its yearly surveillance audit with no major findings.

title: New Data & AI studio opens in Surabaya
summary: Forty data engineers and applied scientists join the new studio to help clients put AI agents into production.

title: Graduate programme welcomes its largest intake yet
summary: 120 graduates start a twelve-month programme that rotates through cloud, data, security and product teams.

title: Contoso and the City of Fabrikam pilot a citizen services app
summary: Residents can now request permits and track their status online, with accessibility tested by real users.
